'''Houjix cheese''' was a type of [[Cheese/Legends|cheese]] made from the [[Milk/Legends|milk]] of the [[Houjix/Legends|houjix]]. Crumbled Houjix cheese was served as part of [[goatgrass salad]]s in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and most likely also on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] and [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]].<ref name="Menu" />
